name: LQS - Core: handle inbound message
description: The supervisor ladder, section 5 of the spec. Persist, debounce, lock, muted check, extract, save, escalation check, question detour, decide, re-check before speaking, send. Every flow-control decision in the system lives here and nowhere else.

parameters.query: with ins as (insert into lqs.messages (conversation_id, direction, channel, external_message_id, body, raw, created_at) values ($1::uuid, 'inbound', $2, $3, $4, $5::jsonb, now()) on conflict do nothing returning id), touch as (update lqs.conversations set last_inbound_at = now(), updated_at = now() where id = $1::uuid and exists (select 1 from ins) returning id) select coalesce((select id from ins)::text, '') as message_id, (select count(*) from ins)::int as inserted, coalesce((m.buffer_seconds->>$2)::int, 5) as buffer_seconds, (m.thresholds->>'lock_seconds')::int as lock_seconds, (m.thresholds->>'slot_max_attempts')::int as slot_max_attempts, c.market_id as market_id from lqs.conversations c join lqs.markets m on m.id = c.market_id where c.id = $1::uuid;

with conv as (select * from lqs.conversations where id = $1::uuid), newest as (select id from lqs.messages where conversation_id = $1::uuid and direction = 'inbound' order by created_at desc, id desc limit 1), decision as (select case when (select id from newest)::text <> $2 then 'superseded' when (select bot_muted from conv) then 'muted' when (select processing_until from conv) is not null and (select processing_until from conv) > now() then 'locked' else 'proceed' end as gate), take_lock as (update lqs.conversations set processing_until = now() + make_interval(secs => $3::int), updated_at = now() where id = $1::uuid and (select gate from decision) = 'proceed' returning id), mark_muted as (update lqs.messages set processed_at = now() where conversation_id = $1::uuid and direction = 'inbound' and processed_at is null and (select gate from decision) = 'muted' returning id) select (select gate from decision) as gate;

select (select coalesce(string_agg(mm.body, chr(10) order by mm.created_at), '') from lqs.messages mm where mm.conversation_id = c.id and mm.direction = 'inbound' and mm.processed_at is null) as combined_text, (select coalesce(json_agg(t.j order by t.created_at), '[]'::json) from (select json_build_object('direction', direction, 'body', body) as j, created_at from lqs.messages where conversation_id = c.id order by created_at desc limit 6) t) as history, (select coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('slot_key', sd.slot_key, 'value_type', sd.value_type, 'extraction_hint', sd.extraction_hint, 'choices', case when sd.value_type = 'enum' then (select coalesce(json_agg(ch->>'value'), '[]'::json) from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(sd.question_choices, '[]'::jsonb)) ch) else '[]'::json end) order by sd.priority), '[]'::json) from lqs.slot_definitions sd where sd.market_id = c.market_id and sd.deal_type = c.deal_type and sd.active) as applicable_slots, (select coalesce(json_object_agg(q.slot_key, q.value), '{}'::json) from lqs.qualification q where q.conversation_id = c.id and q.state in ('filled', 'conflicted') and q.value is not null) as filled_values, c.language as language, c.market_id as market_id, c.deal_type as deal_type, coalesce(l.timezone, m.timezone) as lead_tz, m.disclaimers as lines, (select to_char(bk.starts_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') from lqs.bookings bk where bk.conversation_id = c.id and bk.status = 'confirmed' order by bk.created_at desc limit 1) as confirmed_starts_at from lqs.conversations c join lqs.leads l on l.id = c.lead_id join lqs.markets m on m.id = c.market_id where c.id = $1::uuid;

with b as (select exists(select 1 from lqs.bookings bk where bk.conversation_id = $1::uuid and bk.status = 'offered') as awaiting), upd as (update lqs.conversations set unparsed_streak = case when (select awaiting from b) then unparsed_streak when $2::boolean then unparsed_streak + 1 else 0 end, repeat_streak = case when (select awaiting from b) then repeat_streak when $3::boolean then repeat_streak + 1 else 0 end, language = coalesce(language, nullif($4, '')), updated_at = now() where id = $1::uuid returning id, market_id, unparsed_streak, repeat_streak, language) select upd.unparsed_streak as unparsed_streak, upd.repeat_streak as repeat_streak, upd.language as language, m.thresholds as thresholds, (select q.value from lqs.qualification q where q.conversation_id = upd.id and q.slot_key = 'budget') as budget, (select q.value from lqs.qualification q where q.conversation_id = upd.id and q.slot_key = 'payment_method') as payment_method, (select awaiting from b) as awaiting_slot_choice from upd join lqs.markets m on m.id = upd.market_id;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$('Resolve Identity').item.json.conversation_id, ($('Extract Facts').item.json.unparseable === true || $('Extract Facts').item.json.ok === false), $('Extract Facts').item.json.is_repeat_of_previous === true, $('Extract Facts').item.json.language || ''] }}

parameters.query: with mark as (update lqs.messages set processed_at = now() where conversation_id = $1::uuid and direction = 'inbound' and processed_at is null returning id) update lqs.conversations set processing_until = null, updated_at = now() where id = $1::uuid returning (select count(*) from mark)::int as marked;

select case when (select mm.id from lqs.messages mm where mm.conversation_id = $1::uuid and mm.direction = 'inbound' order by mm.created_at desc, mm.id desc limit 1)::text = $6 then 'ok' else 'superseded' end as gate, $2::text as reply_text, $3::text as slot_key, $4::boolean as asked_slot, $5::text as action;

with mark as (update lqs.messages set processed_at = now() where conversation_id = $1::uuid and direction = 'inbound' and processed_at is null returning id) update lqs.conversations set processing_until = null, updated_at = now() where id = $1::uuid returning (select count(*) from mark)::int as marked;

with uc as (update lqs.conversations set status = 'nurture', updated_at = now() where id = $1::uuid returning id, lead_id, language, market_id), ul as (update lqs.leads set status = 'nurture', updated_at = now() where id = (select lead_id from uc) returning id) select coalesce(m.disclaimers->'nurture_line'->>coalesce((select language from uc), 'en'), m.disclaimers->'nurture_line'->>'en', 'Thanks for your time.') as nurture_line, (select id from ul) as lead_id from lqs.markets m where m.id = (select market_id from uc);

with mark as (update lqs.messages set processed_at = now() where conversation_id = $1::uuid and direction = 'inbound' and processed_at is null returning id) update lqs.conversations set processing_until = null, updated_at = now() where id = $1::uuid returning (select count(*) from mark)::int as marked;

with mark as (update lqs.messages set processed_at = now() where conversation_id = $1::uuid and direction = 'inbound' and processed_at is null returning id), attempt as (insert into lqs.qualification (conversation_id, slot_key, state, attempts, updated_at) select $1::uuid, $2, case when 1 >= $4::int then 'unanswered' else 'empty' end, 1, now() where nullif($2, '') is not null on conflict (conversation_id, slot_key) do update set attempts = lqs.qualification.attempts + 1, state = case when lqs.qualification.attempts + 1 >= $4::int and lqs.qualification.state in ('empty', 'unanswered') then 'unanswered' else lqs.qualification.state end, updated_at = now() returning slot_key), conv as (update lqs.conversations set questions_asked = questions_asked + case when $3::boolean then 1 else 0 end, processing_until = null, updated_at = now() where id = $1::uuid returning id, questions_asked) select (select count(*) from mark)::int as marked, (select questions_asked from conv) as questions_asked;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$('Resolve Identity').item.json.conversation_id, $('Recheck Newest Message').item.json.asked_slot ? $('Recheck Newest Message').item.json.slot_key : '', $('Recheck Newest Message').item.json.asked_slot === true, $('Persist Message').item.json.slot_max_attempts] }}

parameters.query: update lqs.conversations set processing_until = null, updated_at = now() where id = $1::uuid returning id;
select bk.offered_slots as slots, bk.id as booking_id from lqs.bookings bk where bk.conversation_id = $1::uuid and bk.status = 'offered' order by bk.created_at desc limit 1;

with upd as (update lqs.bookings set status = 'declined' where conversation_id = $1::uuid and status = 'offered' returning id), conv as (update lqs.conversations set booking_declines = booking_declines + 1, updated_at = now() where id = $1::uuid returning booking_declines) select (select count(*) from upd)::int as offers_closed, (select booking_declines from conv) as declines;
